title: Let's Learn English Lesson 45
subtitle: This Land is Your Land
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 45: This Land is Your Land (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know I love Washington, D.C. But I want to see more of the United States. My roommate Marsha and I will be on vacation at the same time. So, we are going on a road trip together!
dialogue.zh: 你知道我愛華盛頓特區。可我想看看更多的美國。室友瑪莎和我會在同一時間休假。所以，我們要一起公路旅行！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，瑪莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I packed my bags and I am ready to go!
dialogue.zh: 我行李打包好了，準備出發！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Did you make a list of all the places you want to see?
dialogue.zh: 你把想去的地方都列清單了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did. I want to see New York City and the Statue of Liberty!
dialogue.zh: 列了。我想看紐約市和自由女神像！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And I want to see Mount Rushmore!
dialogue.zh: 我想看拉什莫爾山！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mount Rushmore.
dialogue.zh: 拉什莫爾山。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And don't forget the Grand Canyon!
dialogue.zh: 還有，別忘了大峽谷！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's not forget California's redwood forest! There are so many places to see!
dialogue.zh: 也別忘了加州的紅杉林！要看的地方太多了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We will be driving for a long time. So, we might get bored.
dialogue.zh: 我們會開很久。所以，我們可能會無聊。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bored? No way! We can talk.
dialogue.zh: 無聊？才不會！我們可以聊天。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Or not talk.
dialogue.zh: 或者不聊。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We can play word games. We can sing! You know, our trip is like that famous American song. "This land is your land, This land is my land …"
dialogue.zh: 我們可以玩文字遊戲。我們可以唱歌！你知道，我們的旅行就像那首著名的美國歌。“這土地是你的，這土地是我的……”

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: "…from California to the New York island ..."
dialogue.zh: “……從加州到紐約島……”

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Marsha
dialogue.en: "... to the redwood forest to the Gulf stream waters ... this land was made for you and me!"
dialogue.zh: “……到紅杉林，到墨西哥灣流……這土地是為你和我而造的！”

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Will we be stopping soon?
dialogue.zh: 我們很快會停一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We won't be stopping soon.
dialogue.zh: 我們不會很快停。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'm hungry.
dialogue.zh: 我餓了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, we just left D.C.! We'll be eating lunch in about 2 hours. Can you wait?
dialogue.zh: 瑪莎，我們剛離開華盛頓特區！大約 2 小時後才吃午飯。你能等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I guess.
dialogue.zh: 那就等吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here, have an apple. It's organic!
dialogue.zh: 給，吃個蘋果。是有機的！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Okay, we will be arriving in New York City very soon!
dialogue.zh: 好，我們很快就要到紐約市了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I can't wait to see The Big Apple! Marsha, look! There she is!
dialogue.zh: 我等不及要看大蘋果城了！瑪莎，看！她在那兒！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: The Statue of Liberty!
dialogue.zh: 自由女神像！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She is awesome!
dialogue.zh: 她太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, in ten minutes, guess what we'll be seeing?
dialogue.zh: 瑪莎，再過十分鐘，猜我們會看到什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What?
dialogue.zh: 什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The largest rocking chair in the world!
dialogue.zh: 世界上最大的搖椅！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: No, we won't be seeing that.
dialogue.zh: 不，我們不會去看那個。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, it's on my other list -- Best Roadside Sights.
dialogue.zh: 瑪莎，它在我另一份清單上——最佳路邊景觀。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh no! We littered! And my list is gone. Don't worry. I brought the book.
dialogue.zh: 哦不！我們亂丟垃圾了！我的清單也沒了。別擔心。我帶了這本書。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … and that is why I am so afraid of sheep.
dialogue.zh: ……所以我才那麼怕羊。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow, I feel better. Marsha, you are a great listener.
dialogue.zh: 哇，我感覺好多了。瑪莎，你真是個很好的傾聽者。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Where are we?
dialogue.zh: 我們在哪兒？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We will be entering North Dakota any minute now!
dialogue.zh: 我們馬上就要進入北達科他州了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: North Dakota! We are going in the wrong direction! We want to go to South Dakota!
dialogue.zh: 北達科他州！我們走錯方向了！我們要去南達科他州！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No problem. I will just exit the highway. We will be going south … in just a minute. There. Done! We're going south! Okay, we will be stopping for gas and a bathroom break in about an hour.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我這就下高速。我們馬上……往南走。好了。完成！我們在往南了！好，大約一小時後我們會停下來加油和上廁所。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Then we will be very near to Mount Rushmore!
dialogue.zh: 然後我們就很靠近拉什莫爾山了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yay! Dead presidents' heads on the side of a mountain!
dialogue.zh: 耶！山上的已故總統頭像！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We did it, Marsha! We made it to California! It's beautiful!
dialogue.zh: 我們做到了，瑪莎！我們到加州了！真美！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And we saw everything on the list!
dialogue.zh: 而且清單上的都看到了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, we saw everything on page 1 of the list.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我們看完了清單第 1 頁上的所有地方。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What do you mean "page 1?"
dialogue.zh: “第 1 頁”是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Here are pages 2, 3 and 4! We'll be very busy driving back to Washington, D.C. Until next time … !
dialogue.zh: 哦。這兒還有第 2、3、4 頁！我們開車回華盛頓特區會很忙。下次見……！

quiz.prompt: Who goes on the road trip with Anna?
Which famous song do they sing?
Which state do they enter by mistake?
